note: Every curated resource sits at mock-verified: green against the bundled mock, and nothing more. This repository does have live-read history — Phase-2/3 plugins carry payload shapes captured against a real lab Orchestrator, and six template-section names were confirmed against a real Default Template Group (docs/sitrep/2026-08-26-fanout.md, docs/sitrep/2026-08-26-handoff.md) — but not one of those observations recorded the Orchestrator version it was made against, so none of them can promote a resource past mock-verified. That is the finding, not a gap in the tooling: an observation without a version tells the next operator nothing about their fabric. docs/live-validation.md is the protocol for producing evidence that does count.
